milestone_description: Finite version of the first estimate in Lemma 2 of Lagdive, Aglave and Damre. Let a finite set carry weights w ≥ 0 with total mass one. Let U,V be real functions with identical weighted laws, expressed as equality of weighted expectations for every real test function. For every real centre m and a ≥ 0, if V − U ≤ a wherever w is nonzero, then E[(U − V)²] ≤ 4a E[|U − m|] + a². No independence or two-sided displacement bound is assumed. The linked theorem already has an ACCEPTED proof and is a dependency of the main theorem's accepted reduction. Source: https://github.com/log-prathm/ptf-average-sensitivity/blob/5e9f26cf74935f08be20f9ac4deb57b291d707d8/paper/main.tex .
